story: At 5:17 on a breezy, clear Thursday in Sumter Oaks, Gary is relieved to be heading into Town Square after a long day at Town Hall. Donna is puttering around the Rec Center, eager for whatever comes next, while Hal strolls down Magnolia Loop feeling content. Back at her dining table, Rosa is laying out place settings and sketching a seating chart so that Hal, Gary, and Donna all end up sitting together.
events: Donna waited: puttering around Rec Center
Hal headed to Magnolia Loop (the street).
Rosa (rosa dining table): Lay out place settings and sketch the seating chart so Hal, Gary and Donna are mixed together

gary.thought_process: Tick 156 I filed the Architectural Review application for the cart lights and sound system, so the paperwork is done. Nobody else is here, and there's nothing more to do at the desk. I should stop puttering at Town Hall and get on with the actual cart rigging. Dinner at Rosa's was mentioned, and Hal's helping Rosa at five-thirty, so heading back toward the street to work on the cart makes sense. I'll move to town_square on my way home.

parameters.content: Application's filed, so I'm heading home to start wiring up the cart.

donna.thought_process: I've reserved the court for two hours, warmed up with serves and dinks, and Gary hasn't shown yet. Nobody's nearby to talk to. I already checked the ladder board and signed us up, so no need to repeat that. Best use of this hour is to keep working on my third-shot drops on court 1 so we're sharp when Gary arrives, and then head to Rosa's with my lemon bars after the match.
donna.engine_note: tried to use None, which isn't in rec_center

hal.thought_process: The chair is already checked, bolt tightened, and sitting by the door. It's 5:17 and Rosa asked me to come around five-thirty to help set up the long table. Gary's paperwork is filed and we start Saturday with a clean slate, so the violation notebook can stay shut for tonight. Nothing left to do here but head over to Rosa's with the chair.

parameters.content: Carrying the sturdy chair over to Rosa's so I can help her set up the long table by five-thirty.

rosa.thought_process: I'm home at 5:17 PM Thursday, and everyone is confirmed for Saturday at six: Gary, Hal and Donna. The bulletin board note is up, so no one needs another invite. What's left is the menu and the table. Donna has the lemon bars, Hal has cornbread and a chair, and I need to plan the mains and the seating so the three of them mix. The dining table is the right object to work at, so I'll sketch out the seating chart and the menu there.

parameters.content: Lay out place settings and sketch the seating chart so Hal, Gary and Donna are mixed together

laws.title: Cart Modifications
laws.text: Exterior golf cart modifications visible from the street require Architectural Review approval.

laws.title: Lawn Ornaments
laws.text: No more than 3 decorative ornaments may be visible from the street.

laws.title: Quiet Hours
laws.text: No amplified sound from 10 PM to 7 AM.

laws.title: Holiday Decor
laws.text: Holiday lighting is permitted from Thanksgiving through January 15.

laws.title: Court Reservations
laws.text: Pickleball courts may be reserved for a maximum of 2 hours per party.

laws.title: Parking
laws.text: No parking on the grass. Carts and cars stay on driveways or the street.
